# Buttercup Advertising Studio

> Award-winning creative branding, brand strategy, visual identity, and advertising agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Led by Creative Director & Founder Sneha Vakta Shah.

Buttercup Advertising Studio (BAS) crafts bold brand identities, strategic narratives, packaging design, and modern interactive digital experiences for ambitious businesses across India and internationally.

## Core Services
- [Brand Strategy](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/brand-strategy/): Market positioning, audience persona architecture, competitive benchmarking, and core brand manifestos.
- [Visual Identity](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/visual-identity/): Custom logo marks, typography hierarchies, brand guidelines, stationery, and packaging design.
- [Brand Communication](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/marketing-communication/): Multi-channel campaign direction, creative copywriting, digital narratives, and launch campaigns.
- [Product Base Industries](https://buttercup.in/pages/industries/product-base/): Branding for FMCG, Cosmetics, Textiles, Jewellery, Industrial Lubricants, Pharmaceuticals, and Medical Devices.
- [Service Base Industries](https://buttercup.in/pages/industries/service-base/): Branding for Management Consulting, IT, Real Estate, Hospitality, Healthcare, and Finance.
